data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Atifah', meaning 'noble' and 'dignified'. This name is mentioned in Hadith and Sunnah, signifying respect and reverence towards God and His Messenger. The name Atifa carries the meaning “Noble, Dignified” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Atifa usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, dignified and live with faith, good character and purpose.
